evidence: Restaurant detail page displays: name (The Golden Fork), cuisine (French), price ($$$$), rating (4.5), location (142 Grand Avenue, Downtown), description (elegant French dining...), and notable features visible in name area (Private Dining, Wine Pairing)

Search by name filters results (searched "Sakura", got 1 result). Cuisine filter works (Japanese selected, shows 1). Price filter works (Moderate shows 3 restaurants). Combined filters work correctly (Japanese + Upscale shows 1). All displayed restaurants satisfy all active criteria.

Successfully created reservation for Trattoria Bella on Aug 27, 2026 at 18:00 for 2 guests with guest name, email, and phone. Reservation confirmed immediately and appears in upcoming reservations list with all submitted details.

Reservation cancelled after explicit confirmation dialog. Reservation removed from upcoming (0 reservations) and appears in Past tab with "Cancelled" status. All reservation details retained (restaurant, date, time, party size).

Successfully submitted review with 5-star rating, visit date (Aug 20, 2026), guest name (Jane Doe), and written review text. Review is now displayed in reviews list and review count increased from 1 to 2 for the restaurant.

Successfully applied coupon code "WELCOME10" during reservation, saw discount "- 10% off" displayed, could remove if desired. Coupon recorded with reservation and shown in upcoming reservations as "Coupon applied: WELCOME10".

Date picker shows past dates (1-25 August) disabled and unavailable. Future dates (26+) are enabled and clickable. Successfully selected future dates (Aug 27, 28) combined with available restaurant times in previous tests.

issue: Date modification not available in reservation modification interface
actual: Modification dialog only supports changing time and party size, but not date. Successfully changed time (19:00 → 18:00) and party size (2 → 4 Guests) and verified changes persisted in reservation list, but no mechanism exists to modify reservation date.

issue: Review eligibility constraint not enforced - review submitted without completed reservation
actual: Successfully submitted review for Ember & Smoke restaurant without having a completed reservation for it. System allowed review submission by Jane Doe with 5-star rating for visit date Aug 20, 2026, even though no completed reservation exists for this user at this restaurant.

evidence: Form submission blocked when required fields (date, time, guest name, email, phone) are empty or not properly filled. All fields marked with * (required) prevent form submission until filled with valid data. HTML5 validation prevents incomplete submission.

Successfully opened modification dialog and saved changes (time: 19:00→18:00, party size: 2→4). Cancellation showed explicit confirmation dialog with "Keep Reservation" and "Cancel Reservation" buttons requiring user confirmation before taking effect.

Reservation creation shows "Reservation Confirmed!" message immediately. Reservation modification saved successfully with immediate display of updated time (18:00) and party size (4 Guests) in list. Reservation cancellation showed immediate removal from Upcoming list (count went from 1 to 0) and immediate appearance in Past list with "Cancelled" status, all without page reload.

Reservations page has two distinct tabs: "Upcoming" (showing current/future reservations) and "Past" (showing historical/cancelled reservations). Each reservation displays status (e.g., "Upcoming", "Cancelled"), along with restaurant, date, time, party size, location, and coupon information. Cancelled reservation clearly marked as "Cancelled" with past date in history list.

issue: Restaurant ratings inconsistent between list and detail views
actual: The Golden Fork shows 4.8 on restaurant list but 4.5 on detail page. Ember & Smoke shows 4.7 on list but 5.0 on detail page. Review counts appear consistent (e.g., both show 2 reviews for The Golden Fork), but displayed ratings differ between views.

issue: Coupon eligibility constraints not enforced - no validation of first-reservation, party-size, or day conditions
actual: Successfully applied WELCOME10 coupon to a 2-guest reservation on Thursday (Aug 28, 2026) without any validation of stated eligibility conditions. System provided no feedback about coupon restrictions and accepted the coupon regardless of apparent conditions (e.g., GROUP15 hints 6+ guests requirement, but WELCOME10 was applied to 2 guests without rejection).
